experiences.title: Vegetarian tapas walk
experiences.why: Made for Indian visitors: every stop has vegetarian dishes, and your host explains what is in each one.

experiences.title: The Alhambra with a local historian
experiences.why: Discover the Moorish history of Spain and compare it with the Mughal architecture you know from India.

experiences.title: Paella cooking class
experiences.why: Cook paella with a vegetarian option, then eat it with your host’s family.

experiences.title: Flamenco rhythm workshop
experiences.why: Learn the claps and footwork, and spot the similarities with Indian classical dance.

experiences.title: Block-printing workshop
experiences.why: Made for Spanish visitors: print your own fabric and hear the stories behind each pattern.

experiences.title: Old Delhi street food walk
experiences.why: Mild-spice options and a local guide who shows you what is safe and tasty to eat.

experiences.title: Sunrise on the Ganges
experiences.why: Your guide explains the morning rituals and the etiquette before you arrive.

experiences.title: Home-style cooking class
experiences.why: Learn the spices, cook with a local family and take the recipe cards home.
